fusions.name: Ferrous Spark
fusions.desc: Fires a spark of magnetised iron that deals 8 damage, with a 25% chance to leave the target [Muddled] for 3 seconds. Also costs 4% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Grounding Pulse
fusions.desc: Earths the raw magic around you through cold iron, dealing 28 damage that ignores resistances to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Earth the Charge
fusions.desc: Removes up to 3 conditions from you and restores 12 health.

fusions.name: Grounded Casting
fusions.desc: Each time you spend mana, you gain a shield worth 8% of your maximum health for 5 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
